request_preview: Can you do 25% off if I take three?

json.message: I can't go quite that deep, but I'd be happy to put together a great volume discount for three units. Which appliance are you looking to pick up today?
json.rationale: Clarifying the specific SKU the customer wants while anchoring expectations below their 25% ask and within our discount authority.
